name: MO-07
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Eric Burlison running with large financial edge
Democrat Missi Hesketh raised only ~$50k with no outside support
model.rationale: The R+21 district, Burlison's incumbency, and his roughly 29-to-1 fundraising advantage over Hesketh leave the Democrat with no visible path, and markets agree at about 95% Republican. With no polls or expert ratings available, the forecast stays anchored to fundamentals.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or major outside spending against Burlison is the only realistic way this moves toward competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Southwest Missouri's 7th District is one of the most Republican seats in the country, with a partisan lean of about 21 points toward the GOP. First-term incumbent Eric Burlison was renominated and enters the general election with roughly $1.5 million raised and nearly $1 million on hand.

Democratic challenger Missi Hesketh has raised only about $50,000, and no outside groups are engaged on either side. A Libertarian candidate also appears on the ballot. Prediction markets give Burlison about a 95% chance of winning. With no public polling of the race, the fundamentals point to a comfortable Republican hold.
